items.title: How many vague misses before a reader stops believing your estimates?
items.description: Path A in this unit strung together three consecutive 'almost there' updates that each turned out wrong before naming the real cause. Trust doesn't fall off a cliff at any single miss — it compounds downward, so the third vague miss costs more than the first because it's judged against the two before it. Drag the slider to see how many consecutive vague, unfalsifiable estimates it takes before a reader's trust bottoms out — the default (3) matches Path A's actual pattern.
items.compute: const trust = Math.round(100 * Math.pow(0.6, params.consecutiveMisses)); return { trust };
